title: Architecture Governance Model
summary: The overall model of how data and architecture decisions are governed — layered decision rights, roles, lifecycle, controls and change process — treated as a first-class architectural layer.
body_markdown:
# Architecture Governance Model

## Purpose

Define how governance works as an architectural layer: who decides what, at which layer, on which basis, with which evidence, and how decisions are recorded, published and changed.

## Scope

Architecture and data governance for the organisation's data landscape, and — by application of the same model — this knowledge base ([[Knowledge Repository Governance]]).

## Model

```text
            ┌──────────────────────── Governance layer ────────────────────────┐
Standards → │ Decision Rights Model → Roles → Lifecycle → Controls → Change Process │ → Recorded decisions
Principles  └──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
                     │ applies per architecture layer
     Business · Conceptual · Semantic · Information · Logical · Physical · Technical
```

| Component | Answers | Object |
|---|---|---|
| Decision rights | Who can decide what, at which layer? | [[Decision Rights Model]] |
| Roles | Who plays which part? | [[Governance Roles]] |
| Lifecycle | Through which states does an artifact move? | [[Governance Lifecycle]] |
| Controls | What must be checked, with which evidence? | [[Mandatory Metadata Control]], [[Architecture Review Control]], … |
| Change process | How are changes proposed, validated, approved, implemented? | [[Architecture Change Process]] |
| Quality | How trustworthy is the knowledge? | [[Knowledge Quality Model]] |
| Terminology | How are terms and meanings governed? | [[Terminology Governance]] |

## The governance questions (spec §10)

| Question | Answered by |
|---|---|
| Who can decide? | [[Decision Rights Model]], role objects |
| What can they decide? | decision rights per layer |
| At which architectural layer? | [[Architecture Layer]] |
| Based on which standards? | standard objects, principles, `constrained-by` links |
| What evidence is required? | controls (Evidence section) |
| Who approves? | approver per layer in [[Decision Rights Model]] |
| What is generated after approval? | [[Architecture Change Process]] step "Artifact Generation" |
| How is the decision recorded? | ADR / governance decision objects, Git history |
| How can it be changed? | [[Architecture Change Process]] and lifecycle transitions |

[[Governance Is Embedded in Delivery]], [[Decisions Belong to Their Layer]], [[Architecture Decisions Are Traceable]], [[Data Has an Accountable Owner]].
